name: build_runner
summary: The Dart build system commonly used to run source generators such as Freezed, json_serializable, Riverpod generators, and Retrofit generators.
advantages: Provides a common execution model for Dart source generators
Supports one-off build and watch workflows
tradeoffs: Generator stacks can introduce build-time and analyzer-version compatibility constraints
Generated-output conflicts require disciplined workflow and CI checks
recommendedFor: Projects combining multiple Dart build-system generators

verification.reason: Current Dart documentation and pub.dev metadata are sufficient.
